choice:priority.magic.A.text: Full magician. Remember: the astral sees you too.
And the astral remembers. Keep your aura clean and your mouth shut.

choice:priority.resources.A.text: A million nuyen and a head full of chrome. Try not to rust before your first run.
Spend it all before the first run. Nuyen in your pocket is nuyen somebody else is planning to take.

choice:priority.resources.E.text: Five thousand nuyen. That's a pistol and a prayer, chummer.
A pistol, a prayer and a cousin with a couch. I've started with less.
You started with a stolen bicycle, Nine.

choice:essence.low.text: Under two Essence. The street docs call that 'held together by warranty'.
And every tenth of a point you trade is a tenth the healers can't reach.
Held together by warranty and spite. Classic.

choice:magic.with.cyberware.text: Every piece of chrome you put in costs the mana you had. Ask the shamans who traded theirs for a smartlink.
Saw a mage buy a smartlink once. Hit everything he aimed at. Never cast again.
